title: Two Gemini models join the text API
summary:
Two Gemini chat models arrived, DeepSeek got longer responses, and the community project gallery kept growing.

Added `gemini`, based on Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview, and `gemini-thinking`, based on Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental, to the chat model list.

DeepSeek's response limit rose from 4,096 to 8,192 tokens. Audio-model requests that omit a voice now default to `amuch` instead of `alloy`.

The project listings gained AvatarStudio, Herramientas IA, AI Unlimited Customizable Feature Module, and a Chinese children's storybook demo; Elixpo's listing was updated to Elixpo-Art. The storybook entry also gained language metadata and an English description, while the website's estimated image count received updated calculation inputs.

highlights.title: Gemini Flash Lite joins chat
highlights.text: Use `gemini` for chat requests with Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).

highlights.title: Gemini Thinking joins chat
highlights.text: Use `gemini-thinking` for chat requests with Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-thinking).
